pb-hypernode-mcp.description: Hypernode Brancher MCP server — brancher_create/list/delete/ssh_info/exec/put/apps tools for spinning up disposable prod-clone preview environments across one or more Hypernodes. Requires HYPERNODE_API_TOKENS set in the environment before Claude Code starts — a JSON object mapping each Hypernode <appname> to its own API token, e.g. '{"myapp":"token1","myapp2":"token2"}' (read from env only, never written to disk or stored in plugin config). Only apps present in that map can be operated on; brancher_apps lists them.
